name: 3C 239 (Hubble)
blurb: 3C 239, a distant radio galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: 3c239-hubble
story: A faraway galaxy powered by one of the most powerful radio-loud active nuclei of its time, likely on its way to becoming a giant elliptical. Hubble came to see whether its outburst was set off by a merger and what kind of cluster surrounds it.

claims.text: 3C239 is a radio galaxy targeted by Hubble program 16281 (redshift 1.781)
The program's 3CR sources are among the most powerful radio-loud AGNs at such redshifts, hosted by progenitors of the most massive ellipticals
The program tests whether radio-loud AGNs are triggered by major mergers and studies their cluster environments
